categories.main_business_segments: Dalian Haosen Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a supplier of intelligent production lines and integrated intelligent equipment, focusing on automotive powertrain manufacturing. Its main product lines include intelligent production lines for new energy vehicles such as power lithium battery lines, drive motor lines, hybrid powertrain assembly lines, and hydrogen fuel cell production lines, as well as traditional internal combustion engine and transmission assembly lines. The company also develops intelligent manufacturing software and services, and has begun exploring embodied intelligence equipment like humanoid and autonomous mobile robots.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including automation, informatization, intelligent control, flexible manufacturing, and green manufacturing. Key proprietary technologies cover intelligent flexible assembly units, multi-model robot flexible tightening, lithium battery module stacking, hydrogen fuel cell stack automatic stacking, and advanced motor assembly techniques such as U/X-PIN automatic wiring. It integrates robotics, machine vision, laser processing, digital simulation, MES systems, and AI-driven adaptive control to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company also emphasizes R&D in embodied intelligence and AI applications in industrial manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haosen's primary customers are leading global automotive OEMs and core component suppliers, including Mercedes-Benz, BMW, General Motors, Volvo, BYD, SAIC-GM, FAW, and battery manufacturers like CATL and EVE Energy. The company serves both traditional internal combustion engine vehicle manufacturers and new energy vehicle sectors, with a strong focus on powertrain components such as engines, transmissions, electric motors, lithium batteries, and fuel cells. Its markets include domestic Chinese automotive manufacturers and international clients in Europe, North America, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Dalian and subsidiaries in Changzhou, Suzhou, Shenzhen, and other Chinese cities. It has established overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Hungary, and India to support sales, production, and service activities. Overseas orders have grown significantly, with a substantial portion of new contracts and deliveries in Europe, North America, and emerging markets such as Southeast Asia and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haosen operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent production lines and equipment for automotive powertrain manufacturing. It provides turnkey solutions encompassing planning, R&D, design, assembly, commissioning, and after-sales service, enabling OEMs and component suppliers to produce powertrain components efficiently and with high quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in intelligent manufacturing technologies, including AI, robotics, machine vision, digital twins, and embodied intelligence. It focuses on upgrading core technologies for new energy vehicle components such as lithium batteries, electric motors, and hydrogen fuel cells. Strategic initiatives include expanding global operations, enhancing virtual commissioning capabilities, developing flexible and modular production lines, and participating in industry standard setting for embodied intelligence. Haosen also emphasizes talent development and collaboration with academic and industrial partners.
categories.revenue_model: Haosen generates revenue primarily through the sale of customized intelligent production lines and integrated equipment, recognized upon customer final acceptance. It also earns income from software products and related services tailored for manufacturing execution and lifecycle management. The company secures contracts mainly via public tenders and negotiated agreements with automotive OEMs and suppliers, delivering turnkey projects. Additional revenue streams include spare parts sales and leasing income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haosen is a leading domestic player in automotive powertrain intelligent manufacturing equipment, competing with international giants like Comau, KUKA, ThyssenKrupp, and Gläubig, as well as domestic companies such as Tianyong Intelligent and Xianhui Technology. It holds a strong position in traditional engine and transmission assembly lines and is among the top tier in lithium battery module PACK intelligent production lines. The company is recognized for its technological innovation, comprehensive product portfolio, and expanding global footprint, positioning it as a key competitor in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Haosen reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.81 billion, a 9.85% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 87.9 million, reflecting a significant decline compared to prior profitability. Total assets grew by nearly 16% to RMB 6.49 billion, supported by increased fixed assets and ongoing investments. The company maintains a substantial R&D investment ratio (~7.8% of revenue) and has expanded its workforce and overseas operations. Despite recent financial challenges, Haosen continues to invest in technology and market expansion to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haosen emphasizes delivering high-precision, high-efficiency, flexible, and stable intelligent manufacturing solutions tailored to automotive powertrain production. Its competitive differentiation lies in proprietary core technologies, comprehensive turnkey project capabilities, and deep integration of automation, AI, and digitalization. The company’s extensive experience with leading global OEMs, broad product coverage across traditional and new energy vehicle components, and rapid global delivery capabilities provide customers with reliable, advanced, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions that support industry transformation and high-quality development.
